item.title: Chancellor calls for ‘big, audacious ideas’ to lead CU Boulder’s future
item.description: University of Colorado Boulder Chancellor Justin Schwartz delivered his annual state of the campus address on Tuesday, calling on faculty, staff and students to develop big ideas for the university's future.

item.title: CU Buffs women’s basketball locked in for visit to last-place Houston
item.description: Coming off a big win against a top-15 opponent that was leading the conference, the Colorado women’s basketball team could be due for a letdown. Head coach JR Payne doesn’t have much doubt about her team being locked in for a road trip to last-place Houston on Wednesday night, however.

item.title: Federal judge dismisses attempt to obtain Michigan voter data in latest rejection of DOJ
item.description: The DOJ sued at least 23 states and the District of Columbia for voter data.

item.title: PHOTOS: Denver Nuggets host annual Special Olympics basketball clinic
item.description: The Denver Nuggets hosted their annual Special Olympics Basketball Clinic at Ball Arena in Denver on Tuesday, Feb. 10, 2026, with 100 Special Olympics athletes from around Colorado.

item.title: Shootings at school and home in northeastern British Columbia leave 10 dead including shooter
item.description: TUMBLER RIDGE, British Columbia (AP) — Canadian police said eight people were killed in a school shooting on Tuesday in British Columbia, including a shooter, and dozens more were injured. item.title: Douglas County woman billed Medicaid for patient who already died, federal officials allege
item.description: Federal officials unveiled a slew of charges Tuesday against two Coloradans accused of ripping off a program that provides free rides to Medicaid patients.

item.title: Keeler: Nuggets’ home-court advantage with Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray feels like ancient history
item.description: Remember the spring of '22? Ah, yes. The tail end of an up-and-down season marked by key injuries to foundational players -- kinda like this one, now that you mention it.

item.title: Grand jury refuses to indict Jason Crow, other Democratic lawmakers in connection with illegal military orders video
item.description: The Justice Department opened an investigation into the video featuring Democratic lawmakers urging U.S. service members to follow established military protocols and reject orders they believe to be unlawful.

item.title: Alex Pretti’s parents in Colorado open up: ‘No reason he should have died’
item.description: The Prettis said they had tried to keep their focus on their son’s life, and not on the uproar touched off by his death.
